summary: UI radio/check-button state change handler. When the enable flag at this+224 (0xE0) is set, it snapshots the current computed state via ShortComputation_7720, normalizes the first string field (this+160, falling back to byte_5EA438 when null) through StringNormalizeLookup_a460, compares the normalized value against the second string field (this+168, same fallback) via sub_588410, and records the comparison result (v6 == 0) into the validation state via sub_487260. It then re-reads the computed state; if it differs from the snapshot, it dispatches a virtual notification through the vtable at this+0 (entry +44) with argument 1.

local_names.this: UI radio/check control object (vtable at +0, string fields at +160/+168, enable flag at +224)
local_names.obj: same object, alias used for the validation-state write by sub_487260 (offset +44)
local_names.v2: snapshot of computed state at entry, compared after validation
local_names.v3: first string pointer (fallback byte_5EA438 when null)
local_names.v4: normalized lookup result; null guards the comparison block
local_names.v5: second string pointer (fallback byte_5EA438 when null)
local_names.v6: comparison result from sub_588410 (0 means match)

operations.description: Enable gate: when the byte at this+224 (0xE0) is zero the whole handler body is skipped and 0 is returned; otherwise the validation and notification logic runs.
Snapshot the current computed state: ShortComputation_7720() is called with no argument and its result stored in v2 for later change detection.
Load the first string reference from this+160 (0xA0); when it is null, use the global default byte_5EA438.
Normalize/lookup the first string: StringNormalizeLookup_a460(v3) returns v4; a null v4 skips the comparison and validation block.
Load the second string reference from this+168 (0xA8); when it is null, use the global default byte_5EA438.
Compare the normalized first value against the second string: sub_588410(v4, v5) returns v6, where 0 means a match.
Record the validation outcome: sub_487260(obj, v6 == 0) writes the comparison-derived boolean into the validation-state field at obj+44 (0x2C).
Change detection: call ShortComputation_7720(this) again; when the recomputed value differs from the entry snapshot v2, the notification is dispatched.
Virtual notification: (*(this + 0))[44](1) invokes the vtable entry at offset 44 with argument 1 when the state changed.

unresolved: The exact semantic roles of the string fields at +160 (0xA0) and +168 (0xA8), of the validation-state field at +44 (0x2C), and of the argument 1 passed to the vtable+44 notification are interpretations drawn from the existing analysis fill, not independently evidenced.

The identity and purpose of the object (owner type UnknownObject) is not established; callers are VirtualDispatchWithErrorHandling (0x00487530), VTableDispatch_7640 (0x00487640) and UtilityFunction_7e10 (0x00487E10).
The global byte_5EA438 is treated as a default/fallback string, but its exact role (application directory vs empty string) is not proven.
